blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Members of the Senate minority on Saturday urged authorities to hold a dialogue with Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, following the announcement of a P50-million bounty for his capture. In a statement, the minority bloc senators said they stand with Dela Rosa in “defending his right to due process” and support his call to be able to answer accusations against him before local courts. At the same time, the lawmakers said they also understand “the government’s desire to resolve this situation” and stressed that a “peaceful resolution that respects our laws and protects lives remains possible.” READ: Hunt for Bato […]...
